title: Vampire Vape Heisenberg Longfill E-Liquid - 20ml
description: Vampire Vape's iconic Heisenberg, the flavour that skyrocketed them to fame in the vaping world, is now available as a DIY concentrate. This award-winning mix features a burst of mixed berries with a cool menthol finish. It's a must-try for every vaper. Just mix it with your VG/PG base for the best taste. Remember, all Vampire Vape concentrates are 100% PG based. What are Longfills? Longfill e-liquids come with 20ml of flavour in a 60ml bottle, letting you add your preferred amount of nicotine shots and PG/VG. This means you have full control over the strength and ratio of your e-liquid. Unlike shortfills, which only go up to 3mg, Longfills can be mixed to 3mg, 6mg, 9mg, or 12mg strengths. How to Mix Your Longfill : Just open your bottle, add your nicotine shots, then top it up with PG/VG. Shake it well to mix, and it's ready to vape.
